RNA-seq.readouts: platelet RNA expression levels, differential expression, temporal expression trajectories

evidence_location.quote: We isolated platelet‐rich plasma (PRP) from blood samples of participants obtained prior to vaccination (Day 0) and at Days 2, 7, and 28 post‐vaccine for isolation of RNA and elucidation of the platelet transcriptome via RNA‐seq.

flow cytometry.readouts: surface expression/percent positive platelets for CD62p, CD40L, and CD63

evidence_location.quote: The levels of surface expression of all three proteins were significantly increased in platelets from Older (Comm), compared to young adults at day 0, 2, and 7, suggesting an age‐associated increase in platelet activation.
Influenza vaccine antibody response was measured using a standard hemagglutination inhibition assay (HAI).
